# uptimekuma_notification_aliyunsms (Resource)

Aliyun SMS notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_aliyunsms" "example" {
  name              = "Aliyun SMS Notification"
  is_default        = false
  access_key_id     = "your-access-key-id"
  secret_access_key = "your-secret-access-key"
  phone_number      = "+1234567890"
  sign_name         = "YourCompanyName"
  template_code     = "SMS_001"
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: secret_access_key_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change secret_access_key_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_aliyunsms" "write_only" {
  name = "Aliyun SMS with a write-only secret"

  access_key_id = "LTAI0000"
  phone_number  = "13800000000"
  sign_name     = "UptimeKuma"
  template_code = "SMS_000000"

  secret_access_key_wo         = "your-secret-access-key"
  secret_access_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) Aliyun access key ID
- `name` (String) Notification name
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number to send SMS to
- `sign_name` (String) Aliyun SMS sign name
- `template_code` (String) Aliyun SMS template code

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) Aliyun secret access key. Stored in state; use `secret_access_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `secret_access_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Aliyun secret access key, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `secret_access_key`; requires `secret_access_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `secret_access_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `secret_access_key` until the next apply with `secret_access_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `secret_access_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `secret_access_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `secret_access_key_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
